## Outcome

I added a browser-geometry regression test that detected multiline facet strips overlapping the panel and then fixed their placement.

## Context

PR #339 began in Week 3 by splitting multiline labels into SVG `<tspan>` elements. Week 8 addressed the separate layout problem revealed after the lines existed.

## What I Did

- Added a browser-geometry test to [PR #339](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/339) on July 18.
- Measured strip-text and panel positions instead of only checking that multiple `<tspan>` elements existed.
- Updated the renderer so multiline strips sit outside the panel area.
- Improved text measurement to include the height of every line.
- Preserved the behavior across both `facet_grid()` and `facet_wrap()` paths.

## Learnings

Multiline rendering has two distinct requirements: draw every line and reserve enough layout space for every line. DOM-existence tests can pass even when SVG elements overlap the visualization; geometric relationships are the meaningful acceptance condition.

## Challenges / Notes

Font metrics and browser text rendering vary. The test needed to assert a stable relationship between strip and panel boundaries without depending on one exact pixel value.

## Next Week Targets

Address review across custom-height facets, legend control, and positive panel margins.
